title: B1.10 physical interval seam audit

observations.fact: run termination is based on nint(tend) and nint(t1900), therefore calendar-day projection is intrinsic to the legacy controller
t1900 is normalized to dble(nint(t1900)) at the day boundary
the event limiter uses 1.0 - tcum as the end-of-day boundary
the external exchange route explicitly rejects TEND different from TSTART with 'Only single day allowed'
reference execution requires one full trial and two half trials from the same checkpoint

forbidden_shortcut: Do not map a half trial onto a legacy whole calendar day or change reference step-doubling policy to make the adapter fit.
